trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(pd:Document), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(td:Document), (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(cd:Document), (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(od:Document) WHERE pf.tenure = 'latest' AND ((c.city_name = 'Brooklyn' AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) < 0) OR (t.team_name <> 'Detroit Pistons' AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <> 41)) RETURN o.nationality AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2
